title: Agreement between two engine views was proven on fixture anchors only
fix: pnpm parity-probe sweeps every caret in three fixture roots; AGENTS.md and dataflow-engine.md invariant 4 name it; global AGENTS 'Proving a change' rule
lesson: When two code paths must give the same answer, check every input the product accepts, not only the annotated fixtures

title: Two ops kept copies of the same stop rules and the copies drifted
fix: Ledger is the graph laid out as rows (#465); ESLint forbids slice walks and stop rules in value-flow.ts; invariant 4 in docs/dataflow-engine.md
lesson: When two features must agree, derive one from the other and enforce it with an import rule

title: Codex review from Claude was hand-built each time and failed three ways
fix: ~/.agents/skills/codex-review (script pins the SHA, closes stdin, probes the CLI, prints the verdict; 10-round cap); Codex CLI upgraded to 0.171
lesson: A review tool called more than twice needs a wrapper that handles stdin, model, commit pinning and output

title: Byron asked four times for a Codex review before the PR
fix: Global AGENTS: core-logic PRs get a codex-review loop to CLEAN, at most 10 rounds, open findings under Limits
lesson: If the user asks for the same review step on every layer, make it the default for that kind of work

title: survey-gate reused a $TMPDIR worktree whose node_modules macOS cleanup gutted
fix: Worktree in ~/.cache/srcly-survey with a source marker; stale ones removed; install checked by loading the session module
lesson: A tool that reuses a cache dir under $TMPDIR must verify the cache, because macOS deletes old temp files

title: Editing client/ or server/ files moves the survey even with no analysis change
fix: The gate lists the corpus files a change edits whenever it reports moves; AGENTS.md says so
lesson: When a repo is its own test corpus, have the gate say which corpus files changed

title: No documented way for client tests to use real engine output
fix: CODE_MAP points at engine/test/srcly/projection-fixtures.test.ts and SRCLY_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1
lesson: Client logic that projects engine output should be tested on real, drift-checked engine output

title: PR changed hover-card text with no screenshot
fix: pnpm shot --hover (stroke point, re-checked at capture; --selector can name the card); #465 got its screenshots after merge
lesson: If the screenshot tool cannot reach a UI state, add the state to the tool

title: The pgm node's count (9 of 137) was stale; the real count was 13 of 243
fix: AGENTS.md Backlog and global AGENTS: a task names the command behind its numbers and a product-scope done check
lesson: A backlog number without the command that produced it goes stale; store the command

title: zsh read $ref:e as a modifier despite the global rule
fix: PreToolUse hook ~/.claude/scripts/zsh-modifier-guard.py refuses the command
lesson: A shell rule the agent still breaks needs a check, not a second copy of the rule

title: A new worktree started with a copied launch.json: fixed ports and no data-flow engine
fix: bootstrap.sh replaces the exact old srcly config in a linked worktree, with a mktemp backup
lesson: Bootstrap must repair generated config a worktree inherits from the main checkout, not skip it because it exists

title: gh stack init built the stack on a weeks-old local main
fix: gh-stack skill: Trunk freshness section (fetch, compare main with origin/main, gh stack rebase)
lesson: In a worktree setup the local trunk is often stale; check it against origin before building a stack

title: The retro digest missed messages typed while the agent worked
fix: list_sessions.py reads queued_command attachments, stripped of reminders, with a test
lesson: Steering typed mid-turn is stored apart from user turns; a transcript reader must read both

title: Timeline rows needed graph endpoints
fix: Prove one mixed diagram with a row-to-code edge before committing to a layout model
lesson: Prove one mixed diagram with a row-to-code edge before committing to a layout model

title: Issue reference drawings were stronger than the prototypes
fix: Keep the original dataset and a reference drawing beside the candidate at normal viewing size
lesson: Keep the original dataset and a reference drawing beside the candidate at normal viewing size

title: Matching SVGs hid a weak reading experience
fix: Test drawing-only release and dependency questions before counting renderer parity
lesson: Test drawing-only release and dependency questions before counting renderer parity

title: Review hardened two unproven designs
fix: Exercise two thin product alternatives on the same real task before full hardening
lesson: Exercise two thin product alternatives on the same real task before full hardening

title: Codex reviews run on gpt-6.2-astra, not Sol
fix: codex_review.py pins -m gpt-6.2-sol from one constant; reset config.toml model; AGENTS.md says the script owns the model
lesson: A script that depends on a model must pin it, not inherit an editable app default

title: Codex review loops rarely reach CLEAN (3 of 89 rounds)
fix: Cap at 3 rounds; pass = no in-scope P0/P1; round 3 must give an architecture recommendation; personal-project scope note from round 1
lesson: A review loop needs a severity gate and a round cap, or it never ends

title: Every review starts a 'Reply with the word ok.' Codex thread
fix: Drop the probe; detect model_not_found from the review run itself
lesson: Health-check probes that start a full agent session cost tokens and clutter history

title: Codex review output has no fixed format or severity scale
fix: Use --output-schema + -o; script renders a compact table and sets the exit code from severity
lesson: Ask a reviewer model for a JSON schema, not free text, when a script must act on its verdict

title: Codex review threads show the raw prompt as the sidebar title
fix: Start the prompt with 'Codex review · <slug> · r<N>'
lesson: Put a short human title on the first line of any scripted agent prompt

title: Retro script cannot summarize Codex review runs
fix: Add --section reviews to list_sessions.py: rounds per worktree, model, tokens, minutes, verdicts
lesson: Retro tooling should measure each recurring agent loop it is asked about

title: Codex review findings never fed back into guidance
fix: Findings ledger with class/prevent; --hazards before coding; --close promotes checks, tests, standards
lesson: Record each review finding with how to prevent it, and show past classes to the next agent before it writes code
